research_question: Find one public source for a falsifiable FTMO/MT5-relevant market microstructure or session-liquidity mechanism suitable only for later deterministic validation.
mt5_instrument_scope: Any real FTMO/MT5 tradable symbol class is allowed, but prediction markets are out of scope.
prior_lessons: Stage-0 may only produce source-backed hypotheses, not profitability, WFA, MT5, promotion, or deployment claims.
